question: What is the primary purpose of integrating electronic communication into clinical workflows?

options.A: Eliminating the need for verbal shift handovers entirely
options.B: Streamlining workflow and minimizing transcription errors
options.C: Reducing hospital operational budgets through software
options.D: Replacing face-to-face physician rounds with video calls

explanation: Digital communication tools help organize patient data and share updates quickly, which directly reduces the mistakes often made when copying notes by hand. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h1)

question: Why is strict adherence to confidentiality guidelines necessary when using digital health platforms?

options.A: To prevent unauthorized digital access to private patient details
options.B: To comply with software manufacturer licensing agreements
options.C: To ensure that internet service providers do not bill the hospital
options.D: To speed up the network transmission of diagnostic imaging results

explanation: Patient information is legally and ethically protected; digital platforms must be secured to prevent data breaches and maintain patient trust. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h1)

question: What is a major risk associated with utilizing large multidisciplinary group chats in a clinical setting?

options.A: Inability to transmit text messages over mobile data networks
options.B: Mandatory subscription fees for all participating clinicians
options.C: Information overload and notification fatigue among staff
options.D: Automatic deletion of historical patient data after 24 hours

explanation: When too many updates and non-urgent messages flood a shared group, clinicians can easily miss critical patient care instructions. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h2)

question: A staff nurse needs to clarify an unusual medication dosage with the prescribing doctor immediately. Which communication approach is most appropriate?

options.A: Waiting until the next monthly departmental meeting to ask
options.B: Direct individual messaging using a secure institutional platform
options.C: Broadcasting an audio memo to the entire hospital group chat
options.D: Posting the question on the hospital public social media page

explanation: Individual secure messaging allows for targeted, rapid clarification of specific clinical queries without cluttering shared team channels. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h2)

question: Which clinical task is least suitable for a standard video conferencing consultation?

options.A: Reviewing laboratory trend graphs via screen sharing
options.B: Discussing discharge planning with a patient's family
options.C: Conducting a remote mental health check-in interview
options.D: Manual palpation of an acute surgical abdomen

explanation: Physical assessments that require direct touch, such as feeling for abdominal tenderness, cannot be performed through a video screen. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h3)

question: What is an important environmental consideration for a nurse hosting a telehealth video session from a clinical station?

options.A: Turning off all overhead lighting to enhance screen glare
options.B: Maintaining a quiet background to preserve patient privacy
options.C: Allowing walk-in traffic directly behind the camera view
options.D: Ensuring background music is playing to calm viewers

explanation: Controlling the physical environment prevents accidental disclosure of confidential health information and minimizes visual or audio distractions. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h3)

question: Which feature makes Google Meet particularly convenient for quick virtual huddles on mobile devices?

options.A: Built-in electronic health record billing and coding algorithms
options.B: Automatic physical assessment of patient vital signs via Wi-Fi
options.C: Permanent offline storage of all video recordings on the device
options.D: Browser-based accessibility without mandatory software installation

explanation: Google Meet can often be accessed directly through standard web browsers, reducing technical hurdles for quick mobile connections. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h4)

question: Why might a hospital IT department restrict the use of basic consumer-tier video software for patient case reviews?

options.A: Free software applications prevent multiple users from speaking
options.B: Video streaming consumes excessive electricity in the wards
options.C: Consumer platforms automatically print paper copies of all chats
options.D: Basic tiers often lack compliance-grade encryption for health data

explanation: Institutional patient data requires high-level security features to protect privacy, which are frequently absent in standard, free consumer software versions. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h4)

question: What is the primary function of a Learning Management System (LMS) in nursing education?

options.A: Processing payroll and annual leave requests for nursing staff
options.B: Transcribing doctor-patient verbal conversations into medical charts
options.C: Monitoring real-time patient physiological parameters in the ICU
options.D: Acting as a centralized repository for courses, modules, and assessments

explanation: An LMS is specifically designed to organize educational content, host learning materials, and track student or staff academic progress. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h5)

question: How do Learning Management Systems benefit practicing nurses in busy clinical environments?

options.A: By prescribing medications directly to patient electronic profiles
options.B: By replacing all hands-on clinical supervision with automated video tests
options.C: By delivering mandatory continuous education modules without physical attendance
options.D: By automatically completing patient care documentation during shifts

explanation: Online learning modules allow nurses to complete professional development requirements flexibly around their demanding shift schedules. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h5)

question: What action should a nurse take immediately before leaving the computer terminal at the central nursing station?

options.A: Unplug the computer tower from the electrical socket
options.B: Minimize the electronic health record window slightly
options.C: Lock the workstation screen to prevent unauthorized viewing
options.D: Turn off the overhead lights in the entire ward office

explanation: Leaving a computer unlocked allows unauthorized individuals to view or alter sensitive patient records, violating data privacy protocols. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h6)

question: Which of the following is NOT an acceptable practice when handling electronic clinical communications?

options.A: Including full patient names in unencrypted social media chats
options.B: Enabling two-factor authentication on hospital software accounts
options.C: Using complex and unique passwords for clinical login portals
options.D: Minimizing patient identifiers when discussing cases professionally

explanation: Sharing identifiable patient data on unsecured public platforms breaches patient confidentiality and violates healthcare data protection standards. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h6)
